## `jezero`

Command line interface: `jezero <command>`.

Global options, before the command:

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-c`, `--config` `CONFIG` | Path to `jezero.toml`. Default: `$JEZERO_CONFIG`, then `./jezero.toml`. |
| `--version` | Print the version and exit. |

Without a command, in a terminal, `jezero` opens [the app](../how-to/app.md).

### `jezero ui`

Open the Jezero app (also: `jezero` with no command).

```text
jezero ui [-h] [--demo]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--demo` | optional | made-up data, no server needed |

### `jezero find`

Search Jezero with this computer's key, like an agent.

```text
jezero find [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--limit LIMIT] [--demo] query [query ...]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `query` ... | required | 2 to 5 distinctive words |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | optional | only this project |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | optional | maximum results (default `10`) |
| `--demo` | optional | made-up data, no server needed |

### `jezero show`

One memory in full; --newer checks if it changed later.

```text
jezero show [-h] [--newer] [--demo] id
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | required | item id, as shown by `find` (#123) |
| `--newer` | optional | also list newer items on the subject |
| `--demo` | optional | made-up data, no server needed |

### `jezero agents`

Which agents on this computer use Jezero.

```text
jezero agents [-h] [--demo]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--demo` | optional | made-up data, no server needed |

### `jezero connect`

Create this computer's key (asks what it needs).

```text
jezero connect [-h] [--url URL] [--device DEVICE] [--read-only] [--force]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` `URL` | optional | the server, https://YOUR-JEZERO (asked if missing) |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | optional | a name for this computer (asked if missing) |
| `--read-only` | optional | search only, never upload |
| `--force` | optional | replace this computer's key |

### `jezero init`

Create or verify the database.

```text
jezero init [-h]
```

### `jezero check-config`

Validate the config and report missing env vars.

```text
jezero check-config [-h]
```

### `jezero stats`

Item counts per source.

```text
jezero stats [-h]
```

### `jezero search`

Search from the terminal (admin: sees every source).

```text
jezero search [-h] [--source SOURCE] [--project PROJECT] [--limit LIMIT] query
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | required | words to look for (matching is literal) |
| `--source` `SOURCE` | optional | only this source |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | optional | only this project |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | optional | maximum results (default: search.default_limit) |

### `jezero import-jsonl`

Import pre-summarised items from a JSONL file.

```text
jezero import-jsonl [-h] --source SOURCE [--project PROJECT]
                           [--trust {own,external}]
                           path
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | required | JSONL file, one item per line |
| `--source` `SOURCE` | required | source name for the imported items |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | optional | project for items that do not name one |
| `--trust` `TRUST` | optional | trust of the items (one of `own`, `external`) |

### `jezero new-token`

Generate a client token and its SHA-256 digest.

```text
jezero new-token [-h]
```

### `jezero run`

Run connectors once: collect, summarise, store.

```text
jezero run [-h] [--connector CONNECTOR] [--limit LIMIT] [--sample SAMPLE]
                  [--dry-run] [--due]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--connector` `CONNECTOR` | optional | only this connector (default: every enabled one) |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | optional | process at most N units, oldest first |
| `--sample` `SAMPLE` | optional | process the newest N units, cursor untouched |
| `--dry-run` | optional | count work without calling the LLM |
| `--due` | optional | only connectors whose interval_minutes has elapsed |

### `jezero redact-stored`

Apply the current redaction rules to stored items.

```text
jezero redact-stored [-h] [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | optional | count secrets without writing |

### `jezero device`

Devices that upload sessions (Jezero plugins).

```text
jezero device [-h] {approve,list,revoke,rotate} ...
```

#### `jezero device approve`

Accept a device key printed by `jezero_client init`.

```text
jezero device approve [-h] [--sources SOURCES [SOURCES ...]]
                             [--source-prefix SOURCE_PREFIX] [--read-only]
                             name digest
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | name of the device, as given to `jezero_client init` |
| `digest` | required | sha256 of the device key, as printed by the client |
| `--sources` `SOURCES` | optional | what it may read (default `['agent-*']`) |
| `--source-prefix` `SOURCE_PREFIX` | optional | prefix of its sources; anything but 'agent' keeps them out of agent-* readers (default `agent`) |
| `--read-only` | optional | it may read but not upload |

#### `jezero device list`

List clients: devices and token_env clients.

```text
jezero device list [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | optional | print JSON instead of a table |

#### `jezero device revoke`

Remove a client's key; its inbox connectors are disabled, stored items kept.

```text
jezero device revoke [-h] [--remove-connectors] name
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | client to remove, as shown by `jezero device list` |
| `--remove-connectors` | optional | remove its inbox connectors from the config instead of disabling them |

#### `jezero device rotate`

Replace a device key; the old key stops working.

```text
jezero device rotate [-h] name digest
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | device whose key changes |
| `digest` | required | sha256 of the new device key, as printed by the client |

### `jezero connector`

Inspect connectors or make one read its source again.

```text
jezero connector [-h] {list,reset} ...
```

#### `jezero connector list`

Connectors with last run, last success, error and items.

```text
jezero connector list [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | optional | print JSON instead of a table |

#### `jezero connector reset`

Forget a connector's cursor so its next run reads the source from the start; stored items are kept and unchanged ones are skipped by content hash (no LLM calls).

```text
jezero connector reset [-h] [--yes] name
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | connector to reset |
| `--yes` | optional | do not ask for confirmation |

### `jezero resummarize`

Summarise stored items again from their original.

```text
jezero resummarize [-h] [--ids IDS] [--ids-file IDS_FILE]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--ids` `IDS` | optional | comma-separated item ids |
| `--ids-file` `IDS_FILE` | optional | file with item ids, one per line |

### `jezero retag`

Re-apply the source's project hints and the project aliases, without the LLM.

```text
jezero retag [-h] --connector CONNECTOR [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--connector` `CONNECTOR` | required | connector whose items are retagged |
| `--dry-run` | optional | count changes without writing |

### `jezero health`

Report stale or failing connectors (exit 1 if any); alert if set.

```text
jezero health [-h]
```

### `jezero serve`

Run the MCP server.

```text
jezero serve [-h]
```

## `jezero_client.py`

Jezero client: shared core of the Jezero plugins.
Run it with `python3`; it needs Python 3.9 or newer and nothing else. See [the client reference](client.md) for its files and environment variables.

### `jezero_client.py init`

Create this device's key.

```text
jezero_client init [-h] --url URL --device DEVICE [--force] [--no-upload]
                          [--mcp-path MCP_PATH]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` `URL` | required | Jezero server, e.g. https://jezero.example.org |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | required | a short name for this computer |
| `--force` | optional | replace an existing key on this computer |
| `--no-upload` | optional | only read Jezero; never upload this computer's sessions |
| `--mcp-path` `MCP_PATH` | optional | URL path of the server's MCP endpoint, when its admin changed it (default /mcp) |

### `jezero_client.py status`

Check the key with the server and show the queue.

```text
jezero_client status [-h]
                            [--agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent` `AGENT` | optional | the key this agent uses (one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity`) |

### `jezero_client.py setup`

Register the Jezero MCP server in the agents.

```text
jezero_client setup [-h]
                           [--agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}]
                           [--opencode-plugin OPENCODE_PLUGIN]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent` `AGENT` | optional | one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity` |
| `--opencode-plugin` `OPENCODE_PLUGIN` | optional | path to jezero.ts to install for OpenCode |

### `jezero_client.py mcp`

Stdio MCP server that forwards to Jezero with this key.

```text
jezero_client mcp [-h]
                         [--agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent` `AGENT` | optional | one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity` |

### `jezero_client.py hook`

Run a hook (reads the agent's JSON on stdin).

```text
jezero_client hook [-h] --agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}
                          {session-start,user-prompt,stop,session-end}
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | required | one of `session-start`, `user-prompt`, `stop`, `session-end` |
| `--agent` `AGENT` | required | one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity` |

### `jezero_client.py flush`

Upload queued sessions now.

```text
jezero_client flush [-h]
                           [--agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent` `AGENT` | optional | the queue of the key this agent uses (one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity`) |

### `jezero_client.py backfill`

Queue sessions already on this computer.

```text
jezero_client backfill [-h]
                              [--agent {claude-code,codex,opencode,hermes,antigravity}]
                              [--days DAYS] [--hermes-home HERMES_HOME]
```

| Argument | | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--agent` `AGENT` | optional | one of `claude-code`, `codex`, `opencode`, `hermes`, `antigravity` |
| `--days` `DAYS` | optional | default `90` |
| `--hermes-home` `HERMES_HOME` | optional | Hermes profile folder (default: $HERMES_HOME) |

### `jezero_client.py protocol`

Print the instructions given to agents.

```text
jezero_client protocol [-h]
```
